Interface Rule<T>

Type Parameters:
T - the type of the value
public interface Rule<T>
A requirement of a value, and the test of whether a value meets it.

The requirement names what the value must be, not what is wrong with it, so that the same message reads right whether the value meets it or not. It is a text of the display locale, from typed messages.
